scoring_justification: Headline quantity is a set of scalar CRSS values; recompute from raw simulation outputs is infeasible in the verifier sandbox. We compare agent's reported values to paper-derived gold with generous tolerance.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold CRSS values for six precipitate conditions
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted approximate values from published plots
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values correspond to data presented in the paper, used as reference for reproduction verification.

outputs.description: Critical resolved shear stress (MPa) for each of the six precipitate conditions. The condition column identifies the precipitate type, and crss_MPa is the detachment stress.

output_contract.notes: The CSV must include exactly one row per condition with the correct condition identifier and the computed CRSS. The hidden checker will compare crss_MPa values against paper-derived gold using a generous tolerance window; a value equal to or better than the threshold (within tolerance) earns full credit.
